description: HP-43 is the RTO code for the Registration and Licensing Authority (R&LA) in Udaipur, within the Lahaul and Spiti district of Himachal Pradesh. This office provides essential transport services like vehicle registration and driving licenses for the remote Udaipur sub-division and surrounding high-altitude valleys. It plays a significant role in managing vehicular traffic in the geographically isolated Pattan and Miyar regions.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Udaipur, District Lahaul & Spiti, Himachal Pradesh
